capabilities: Mirror a source folder to a target folder via robocopy /MIR
Run syncs manually, on a timer, or shortly after Obsidian starts
Validate paths before syncing and confirm before first sync into a non-empty target
Verify post-sync file presence, sizes, and modified times, with automatic retries
Report robocopy exit codes and destination-path errors
disambiguation: Not a backup or versioned-backup tool; deletions in the source propagate to the target on the next mirror sync.
extras: Windows desktop only (Obsidian 1.5.0+). Uses destructive robocopy /MIR, so extra files in the target can be deleted; the README repeatedly warns it is not a backup tool. Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Bilingual English/Traditional Chinese documentation; further safety and release docs live in docs/SAFETY.md and docs/RELEASE.md.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault or folder mirrored to another local Windows path.

relations.evidence: performs one-way mirror sync from a source folder to a target folder by using Windows robocopy

summary: Windows-only plugin that one-way mirrors a source folder to a target folder using robocopy, with scheduled, startup, and manual sync options.
